title: Engineering Manager
description:
Your mission

As Engineering Manager at Cosuno, you will lead a team of full stack engineers while staying deeply hands-on: you'll spend 60–80% of your time coding, reviewing, and shaping the architecture alongside your team. You are the kind of leader who elevates a team by example — writing code that sets the bar, and building an environment where great engineers do their best work.

Your mission might include:

  • Leading a team of full stack and AI/ML engineers: coaching, regular 1:1s, growth plans, and hiring — while shipping product yourself every week.

  • Owning the delivery and technical quality of your team's roadmap, working closely with your Product Manager to plan, de-risk, and execute.

  • Contributing hands-on across our TypeScript stack (React + Node), from designing features to reviewing pull requests and tackling the hard problems yourself.

  • Raising the team's technical bar through code reviews, architectural guidance, and best practices — including driving the adoption of AI-assisted engineering workflows.

  • Partnering with engineering leadership on team topology, processes, and the technical direction of our platform.

How We Build: Our Engineering Culture

We believe in a calm, collaborative, and productive engineering environment. We trust our engineers and give them the autonomy to do their best work. Our approach includes:

title: Geospatial Data Analyst (f/m/x) in the field of AI & Satellite Data
description:
Baue mit LiveEO den Marktführer in der Satellitenanalyse auf

LiveEO uses satellite data and AI to monitor critical infrastructure at scale. As a Geospatial Data Analyst (f/m/x), you’ll sit at the heart of our operations, working with geospatial and satellite data to make sure our analytics projects are delivered reliably, accurately, and on time.

You’ll work closely with Project Managers, our Operations Support Studio, engineers, and product teams - investigating data, understanding our analytics pipelines, solving delivery issues, and helping us continuously improve how our technology performs in real-world use cases across energy and transportation infrastructure.

This role is a maternity leave cover and is offered on a fixed-term contract for 1 year.


Deine Aufgaben

  • Analyze, validate, and interpret geospatial and satellite data across global customer projects
  • Take ownership of analytics deliveries and help ensure high technical quality and reliability
  • Understand and adapt to different analytics use cases across energy and transportation infrastructure
  • Investigate data and pipeline issues, identify root causes, and communicate findings clearly to engineering teams
  • Work closely with engineers, Project Managers, and the Operations Support Studio to resolve issues and keep deliveries moving
  • Develop a strong end-to-end understanding of our analytics pipelines and identify opportunities to improve efficiency and quality
  • Provide structured feedback to Product and Engineering teams when you identify recurring issues or opportunities for improvement
  • Use AI coding and analysis tools such as Claude or Cursor for data validation, pipeline debugging, and analysis - while critically validating their output before acting on it
  • Work with tools and technologies including QGIS, Python, SQL, AWS, remote sensing tools,

title: (Senior) Software Developer Fullstack (m/w/d)
description:
Ihre Aufgaben

  • Du entwickelst Features und Verbesserungen für beide Seiten unserer SaaS-Applikation – sowohl im Backend (Django / Django REST Framework, FastAPI) als auch im Frontend (React / TypeScript) – dabei setzt du konsequent auf AI-gestützte Entwicklungstools wie GitHub Copilot oder Cursor, um schneller und effizienter zu liefern.
  • Als erfahrener Softwareentwickler arbeitest du eng mit beiden Entwicklungsteams zusammen und stimmst dich mit allen relevanten Stakeholdern (Produktmanagement, UX, Vertrieb etc.) ab.
  • Du treibst unsere AI First Development Culture aktiv mit voran: Du erforschst neue Tools, teilst Best Practices im Team und hilfst dabei, AI sinnvoll in unsere täglichen Workflows zu integrieren.
  • Du unterstützt bei der technischen Dokumentation des Produkts.
  • Du führst AI-unterstützte Code Reviews durch, hilfst beim Einsatz von AI-Tools im Entwicklungsalltag und unterstützt bei der Verteilung von Tickets und der Steuerung der Entwicklung.


Ihr Profil

  • Ein abgeschlossenes Studium der Informatik, eines verwandten Studiengangs mit IT-Fokus, oder eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung zum Fachinformatiker/-in Anwendungsentwicklung.
  • Du hast mindestens 3 Jahre relevante Berufserfahrung in Vollzeit gesammelt – idealerweise in Rollen, in denen du sowohl im Backend als auch im Frontend tätig warst.
  • Du bringst Erfahrung mit Python und der Backend-Entwicklung in Django / Django REST Framework mit; Erfahrung mit FastAPI ist ein Plus.
  • Du bist sicher im Design und der Entwicklung von REST-APIs sowie im Umgang mit relationalen Datenbanken (z.B. PostgreSQL) und ORM-basiertem Datenmodellieren.
  • Du hast praktische Erfahrung mit React und der Entwicklung von Single-Page-Applikationen; du bist sicher im Umgang mit JavaScript / TypeScript und der ES6 Standardbibliothek. Erfahrung mit Frontend-Frameworks wie Ant Design oder Material UI ist ein Plus.</

title: Software Engineer (Backend)
description:
About ExTrac

ExTrac is a decision intelligence company used by governments, defence organisations, financial institutions, and corporates operating in complex, fast-moving environments. Our capabilities fuse curated data sources, domain-specific AI, and deep human expertise to transform information overload into clear, actionable foresight.

Our ambition is to become the analytical backbone that organisations rely on when geopolitical uncertainty becomes an opportunity or a strategic risk. More at extrac.ai.

The Role

We are looking for a Software Engineer to join ExTrac's engineering team to help build and operate the services and pipelines the platform runs on.

ExTrac takes a continuously ingested, multi-source corpus and turns it into products analysts use to make decisions under time pressure. You will help build and run the backend microservices that make that possible: services and databases that expose curated data through APIs, run search and aggregation over large indices, hold application state, and keep the whole thing fast and correct as volume and customer count grow.

The work is broad by design. In a single quarter it spans API and service design, search and database performance, long-running data pipelines, cloud infrastructure, and the deployment tooling underneath all of it. You will own well-defined features and components end to end within a single system across a Go and Python codebase, working alongside the AI team who build our analytical and agentic features, the frontend team who build the web and mobile interfaces, and the analysts and product managers who define what gets built.

What the job involves
